Everything here applies in every phase.

## Measuring

Measure from the closest points of the **bases**. See [Engagement Range](#engagement-range) and the [glossary](/rules/glossary#core).

| Distance | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1" | Engagement Range, *horizontally* |
| 5" | Engagement Range, vertically |

- Units keep **coherency**:
  - within 2" horizontally
  - within 5" vertically
- Check it at the end of every move.

> **Tip:** Use a tape measure, not a ruler.

### Rounding

Never round distances.

## Engagement Range

1. Measure 1" horizontally.
2. Measure 5" vertically.

> **Not confirmed:** Some older FAQs measured differently.
